mentions.name: Mame Sama
mentions.description: A free Android/iOS app for finding vegan resources, primarily within but not limited to Japan. It works like Instagram with a location requirement, letting the community discover and share vegan spots. The backend is written in Zig and the frontend is in Flutter. It is not yet open source, though that is planned, and it is built with no intention to monetize, relying on the community to contribute to its success and maintenance.
